explication: opencode.nvim is a Neovim plugin that connects the editor to an OpenCode server while preserving familiar Neovim workflows. Users submit prompts or commands, optionally enriched with editor context, and can use selection and completion interfaces. The graph also preserves documented event handling, edit review, server discovery, and status capabilities. Source excerpts were not provided, so relationships are limited to those described in the README; paths identify corresponding files in the repository tree.
